pages.note: CLI under test is extension@4.1.3 (published, ./node_modules/.bin/extension --version). WSL detection vars, the Linux path ladder, the /mnt/c Windows fallback list (incl. Ran preview --help plus five live preview invocations: Safari refusal code, E_PREVIEW_NO_DIST not-found frame, dist/extension-js/<browser>/ready.json (command/runId/startedAt/status), the hidden --author/--author-mode aliases and the dist-then-path resolution order all check out; the JSON value shape and the flag table do not.

Every wire string was matched against programs/develop/dev-server/control-bridge/contracts.ts and bridge-entry.ts: CONTROL_WS_PATH '/extjs-control', LogEvent v1 fields, the 7 CommandOps, the 4 gap reasons, 4001/4002/4003/4008 close codes, the 4 REFUSAL_ constants and the reload/ping server frames are all exported and numbered exactly as documented.

Built the same project for chromium and firefox: prefixed key filtering (chromium:/firefox:) and the Gecko service_worker -> background.scripts translation both produce exactly what the page describes, dist/<browser> layout confirmed; the polyfill section omits that dev/start default it on.

dev --help confirms the optional first argument, --browser=edge and --polyfill=true; the init template exists in create --help's catalog and its source is a manifest plus icons; the GitHub/ZIP URL resolution rules are not remotely fetchable here and were left unverified rather than guessed.

A production build of the content template emits exactly content_scripts/content-0.js and rewrites the manifest entry to it; multi-entry, MAIN-world and chromium: prefix behavior matched the manifest pipeline sources. The development-mode hash-suffixed name could not be observed (dev never reached ready in this sandbox) so it is left unverified, not reported.

The only Extension.js-specific claim, that a pages/ special-folder HTML entry is emitted at the same pages/<name>.html path the createDocument url uses, holds in the special-folders-pages build output; the chrome.offscreen API details (single document, AUDIO_PLAYBACK auto-close, Firefox absence) are browser behavior and were not guessed at.

Installed @extension.dev/mcp@10.9.0 and drove a real initialize + tools/list over stdio: all 11 documented tools exist with matching descriptions and every name is under extension_*, but the advertised tool count is stale.

Scaffolded the new-less template with the published CLI to check the package.json the page describes, and cross-checked all 53 catalog templates; the .module.less naming rule and the less/less-loader dependency advice are fine, the pnpm claim and a dangling section heading are not.

build --help confirms --browser firefox --zip --zip-source, and the promised production-build warning for a missing browser_specific_settings.gecko.data_collection_permissions exists (feature-manifest/messages.ts:86 + manifest-lib/gecko-data-collection.ts); AMO account, GUID and credential-rotation behavior needs a store account and was marked unverifiable.

Verified STORE.md presence across the whole template catalog and in three fresh scaffolds, and confirmed a production build packages only dist/<browser> so a root STORE.md never ships; the submission-API mapping table belongs to external deployment tooling and was left unverifiable.
